name: derived-state
about: Questions whose answer is not stored anywhere: it has to be worked out from several things one person said over a year (a count, a total, the members of a set after adds and removes, a sequence of states, the latest value, two latest values combined). Each question lists the events it needs (`needs`); a reader shown fewer cannot derive the answer. `supersedes` maps a needed event to the older ones it replaced, for questions where an outdated value ranked first would most likely be repeated. Distractors share words with the questions but are not needed. Written by hand on 2026-10-21 for docs/research/memderive-2026-10.md. It is NOT the MemDerive dataset (arXiv 2610.25373): that paper and its code could not be read where this was written, so this is our own test of the claim as it was described to us.
